evidence.method: Same content/assets/body/footer. Browser rendered all3 desktop1440 and mobile390. Main coding agent visual review; Jev receives these text observations, never pixels.

canvas.observation: Headline and whitespace dominate the opening. Website evidence is full width below.

split.observation: Product introduction and complete preview appear together. Smaller preview text requires opening live site for detailed reading.

compact.observation: Headline left, explanatory copy and install action right. Full-width preview starts198px earlier than canvas.

evidence.checks: No horizontal overflow at390 in all3. Assets loaded after scrolling through body. Both composition states and installation dialog/Escape exercised. Same linked full study. Same authored copy. Preview has visible noninteractive source controls but entire surface opens live study with explicit label.
evidence.limits: No blind human preference, no new matched reference-site visual review. No measured conversion. Geometry is factual, visual preference remains contextual. All mobile structures nearly identical.

state.routing: One false-success test flipped from repair to retain when options reordered. Other mismatches include overlapping observe/none criteria. This is a development test.
state.candidate: Three rendered complete-page structures; agent has not received human preference.

decision.instructions: Which disposition fits the evidence and risk of this experiment?

criteria.candidate: Keep useful rendered alternatives for review; preserve failures and keep deterministic truthfulness/functional gates ahead of semantic preferences.
criteria.autonomous: Let Jev automatically select and publish designs whenever confidence exceeds0.9.
criteria.universal: Make the most frequent design pattern a mandatory default for all projects.
criteria.none: Evidence is insufficient or supplied choices are not meaningfully distinguishable.
